answer: On this Linux worktree, Phase-0 fan-out filings in WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json yield raw_n=374 typed edges from 122 phase=0 units. After subtracting edges already declared in live PHASE-GRAPH.json and DEPENDENCY-GRAPH.json (or naming a briefing bucket/phase id), novel_n=252 (novel_over_raw=0.673797). All 252 survivors are unit-to-unit DEPENDS_ON edges. IN_PHASE and IN_BUCKET filings and depends-on-Bxx restatements subtract. Only 122/122 phase-0 output files exist here; the measurement is of catalog-filed edges, not of missing artifact bodies. The Windows workflow JSON named in harvest is absent and was not reconstructed. Catalog ADV-0130's 29-raw-to-7-novel figure is cited as prior program language, not re-run: rules/common/fan-out-contract.md is absent.

claims.claim: Phase-0 catalog filings produce raw_n=374 and novel_n=252 under the written matching rule (novel_over_raw=0.673797).
Three planted PHASE-GRAPH PRECEDES restatements are removed by the subtractor; three synthetic novel PRECEDES edges survive.

measurement.formula: novel_n / raw_n after subtracting briefing-declared edges
measurement.matching_rule: A finding is declared if (a) the exact triple is in PHASE-GRAPH PRECEDES or COVERS_PHASE or DEPENDENCY-GRAPH BLOCKED_BY, or (b) IN_PHASE object is a briefed phase id, or (c) IN_BUCKET object is a briefed bucket id, or (d) DEPENDS_ON object is a briefing id (bucket, phase, or dependency-graph node).

mutant_pairs.verbatim_output: mutant would keep plants=3 and novel_n=374; live plants_survived=0 novel_n=252

negative_controls.rejects: a subtractor that leaves any verbatim PHASE-GRAPH restatement in the novel set

negative_controls.observed: skip-subtract would report novel_n=374; live novel_n=252
negative_controls.rejects: reporting novel_n == raw_n by skipping subtraction
